title: Relative differential module of an algebraic-space morphism
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use the chart-normalized structural map $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$ of [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model], restricted to the small affine etale model [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model]. Define $\Omega_{X/Y}$ to be the module of sheafified sectionwise Kahler differentials of this map [def-sfb-sheaf-differentials], transported back by the inverse of the actual affine-basis restriction equivalence. For an affine-basis chart $U$ and a section $s$ of its structure ring, define $\mathrm ds$ in the full small etale module by applying the inverse counit of this equivalence to the universal differential of $s$. Thus both the module and its differentials use the existing sheafification and specified ring map; no differential module, chart map, or inverse-image map is chosen arbitrarily.
